method.difference: A minus B; positive elapsed or CPU difference means B used less
method.ratio: B divided by A; null when A is zero
method.CPU_scope: user and system deltas across the same phase or segment boundaries used for wall and process I/O
method.marginal_field_scope: Timer includes the full incremental branch; not identical to its first and last sample boundaries
method.storage_scope: Sampled regular-file sizes, signed differences, no claim about peaks between samples or byte identity

process_io_units.read_bytes: storage-layer read bytes as reported by Linux
process_io_units.write_bytes: storage-layer write bytes as reported by Linux
process_io_units.cancelled_write_bytes: cancelled write bytes as reported by Linux

method.memory_scope: Current RSS from /proc/self/statm and peak from getrusage are retained separately; peak is process-lifetime, including setup. The two observed sources can differ in accounting.
method.unit_of_replication: fresh process paired by planned pair id, not individual searches
